test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under the Scheme for Protection and Preservation of Endangered Languages of India (SPPEL), the Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) works on protection, preservation and documentation of all the mother tongues/languages of India spoken by less than ________ people, which are called endangered languages
solution:
The correct answer is **__10000__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The** "Scheme for Protection and Preservation of Endangered Languages of India" **was started by the Indian **government **(**SPPEL**).
 
• The** Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL), **Mysore, works on the conservation, recording, and preservation of **all Indian mother tongues **and **endangered** **languages** that are **spoken **by fewer than **10,000 people** nationwide.
 
• **117** **endangered languages **and **mother tongues **from all over India have been selected for study and recording in the scheme's initial phase on the basis of priority.
 
• The** University Grants Commission (UGC)** has also launched **two programs **for the protection of endangered languages, namely** "Establishment of Centres for Endangered Languages in Central Universities"** and** "Funding Support to the State Universities for Study and Research in Indigenous and Endangered languages in India." **
 
• A total of **Rs. 45.89 crores** were made available by the **UGC **and **CIIL **between** 2015–16 **and **2019–20 **under their programs for the preservation of endangered Indian languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• As a means of **communication **and** self-expression**, **language **is a crucial component of any culture.
 
• **Future generations lose **a critical component of the **culture **that is required to fully comprehend it when a **language **is lost to **extinction**.
 
• Due to this, language is now a particularly vulnerable piece of **cultural heritage**, making its preservation even more crucial.
 
• According to statistics from the **United Nations Educational, Scientific, **and **Cultural Organization **("Atlas of Languages in Danger of Disappearing"), there are an estimated **7,000 languages **spoken worldwide today, with the eight most frequent languages being spoken by half of the world's population.
